name: Ore no Seieki de Sangoku Touitsu Shichau Monogatari ~Ryuubi Kan'u Chouhi, Touen no Chikai de Sao Shimai Sengen!~
original_name: オレの精液で三国統一しちゃう物語 ～劉備・関羽・張飛、桃園の誓いで竿姉妹宣言!～
source:
The era of the Three Kingdoms was rife with young women.You are an office worker whose destiny is to unite these scattered ladies under your bulging banner. Travel back in time and have sex with epic heroines Liu Bei, Kan'u, Zhang Fei and others.

STORY
I was a depressed workaday salary man. One day I was getting a bowl of ramen from my local noodle place. That's when her melodious voice drifted to my ears.  

"The time has cum... an new empire rises tumescently...return to our era... the people will celebrate greatly..."
The next thing I knew I was in ancient China!?

I had no idea what was going on and started to walk. A wise old man gifted to me a fabulous scroll that revealed an ancient Way to make men virile and women swoon with excitement.
